add_pointrend_config_to_cfg: add PointRend configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode for instance mask refinement
configure_point_head_params: configure the point head sampling parameters including oversampling ratio and importance sample ratio
set_implicit_pointrend_options: set Implicit PointRend options like image feature enablement and positional encoding
customize_roi_mask_head: customize the ROI mask head feature maps, FC dimensions, and output resolution
review_add_pointrend_config: review the add_pointrend_config function to understand all PointRend configuration defaults
